verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a full-courage Skaarl, you win if you force and punish the dismount.

brief.thesis: Kled's real health bar belongs to Skaarl, not to Kled — while the mount is up he hits like a bruiser and threatens a hook-yank engage, but the instant Skaarl's HP hits zero he dismounts, deals less damage to champions, and swaps his hook for the short-range Pocket Pistol knockback. Fiora's abilities all sit on short, stacking cooldowns (Q 16/14/12/10/8s, W 10/9/8/7/6s, E 15/14/13/12/11s), which is exactly the kit built to chain a full combo into that dismounted window before Kled claws his courage back. At a measured 52.6% win rate over 97 games with an even lane and solo-kill read, this is a genuine coinflip decided by who controls that transition.

theirWindow.when: Skaarl mounted and W off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Kled can throw a 4-attack Violent Tendencies flurry (13-9s cd) plus a Jousting dash-back (13-9s cd) for a real burst window — don't straight-trade autos here, bait with a single Q poke and back off instead.

yourWindow.what: He deals reduced champion damage and loses the Q hook for the knockback Pocket Pistol — commit Q, then the free second Lunge, W if it's up, and Blade Waltz from level 6 onward before he rebuilds courage and remounts.

powerCurve.note: Both melee pokes trade; Skaarl soaks early Q damage
Jousting plus Violent Tendencies outburst before your R
Blade Waltz plus Hydra punishes every dismount hard
Both ultimates recycle fast in skirmishes again

start.why: The run data shows this starting into Kled at 55.8% win rate over 93.4% of picks — the extra sustain and AD let you answer his early Q hook trades without losing the lane economically.

boots.why: Steelcaps are the standard pick here (53.9% over 80.9% of games) because Kled's damage comes from stacked basic attacks — Violent Tendencies' 4-hit flurry and his Jousting auto follow-ups — which the flat damage reduction blunts directly.

core.why: First item in the highest-performing path (65.6% win rate over 32 games) — the sustain and cleave let you win extended Skaarl trades before he dismounts.
Second item in that same path — the damage spike lines up with your level 7-11 power window where you want to fully punish a dismount in one combo.
Closes out the 65.6% win rate build — the damage mitigation is what lets you survive Kled's remount burst in longer skirmishes.

situational.when: you are ahead and want a faster all-in power spike instead of the sustain path
the lane is dragging and you need extra sustain against his poke
fights are going long and you need your short cooldowns back faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Fiora's Q-auto-Q combo lands three hits fast enough to mark Kled before Skaarl's dismount, and the bonus damage taken is what turns your post-dismount window into a confirmed kill instead of just a good trade.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is both the most run (83.7% pick rate) and best-performing (59.2% win rate) pair in this matchup — Ignite denies Skaarl's health regen from courage-building fights and secures the all-in the moment Kled dismounts.

playing.title: All-in only after dismount
playing.detail: The instant Skaarl's bar hits zero, Kled deals less damage to champions and trades his hook for the short knockback Pocket Pistol — commit your full combo right then.

playing.title: Save Riposte for Violent Tendencies
playing.detail: Kled's W empowers 4 attacks with the 4th hitting hardest; timing W's parry into one of those autos negates it and reflects magic damage back for free.

playing.title: Use the free second Lunge to stick
playing.detail: Q can be recast within a couple seconds at no mana cost — bait his Jousting dash or Q throw, then use the second Lunge to close back in during his cooldown.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's bar, not Kled's
playing.detail: His effective health pool is the mount; damage dealt before Skaarl crashes doesn't translate to kill pressure the way post-dismount damage does.

playing.title: Walk out of the Jousting return pass
playing.detail: Jousting can be recast to dash back through the same target — use E's stacking move speed from landed attacks or Lunges to step off that return line instead of tanking it.

playing.title: Bank Blade Waltz for confirmed kills
playing.detail: At 130s on first cast, R is too valuable to poke away — hold it for a dismounted or low-courage Kled where every strike lands clean.

playing.title: Build through the Hydra-Trinity spike
playing.detail: Your level 7-11 power window lines up with that item spike — force skirmishes once Trinity Force is up rather than before it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners and the 52.6% win rate over 97 games are measured from current-patch OP.GG data; the dismount timing, cooldown reads, and trade sequencing are this brief's own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Cut down against Kled. Use [W] to block his (Q). Try to nuke him after he dismounts from Skaal to kill him.
